visual_review.method: view_image used on source and generated result; visually compared.

visual_review.dragon_body_cloud: Added natural soft cloud masses interrupt and conceal the long body/coil; no readily traceable continuous snake loop remains.
visual_review.actual_shaft_extension: New exposed dark-steel rear shaft extends about 250px behind Guan Yu's rear grip toward x25,y325; both existing grip positions and spacing remain unchanged.
visual_review.shaft_rigidity: Extension follows the same straight axis through both hands toward the existing blade mount; no visible bend, kink or second stick.
visual_review.blade_scale: Original blade design, root location, apparent scale and forward position retained; blade was not enlarged to simulate a long handle.
visual_review.foreground_preservation: All three rider faces and clothing, horses, mud, peach blossoms, Yellow Turban story and fleeing foreground enemy visually preserved.
visual_review.occlusion: Extended shaft passes across nonfacial Liu Bei robe/white-horse neck area but does not obscure any rider's face.
visual_review.frame_note: Rear butt lies near left edge; parent should check it under frozen frame, while a long portion remains visible inside artwork.
